script.title: Mappls Integrated With Zoho Arattai

lines.say: Big news for field operations and logistics teams! Mappls has just been officially integrated with Zoho Arattai, bringing powerful mapping and location services directly into your everyday team messaging platform. If you manage remote workers, delivery fleets, or on-site technicians, this update completely changes how your team collaborates, shares locations, and navigates daily field visits without ever needing to jump between multiple separate applications.
lines.tts: Big news for field operations and logistics teams! Mappls has just been officially integrated with Zoho Arattai, bringing powerful mapping and location services directly into your everyday team messaging platform. If you manage remote workers, delivery fleets, or on-site technicians, this update completely changes how your team collaborates, shares locations, and navigates daily field visits without ever needing to jump between multiple separate applications.

lines.say: For the longest time, field teams have struggled with a very frustrating workflow bottleneck. Employees constantly waste precious minutes switching back and forth between separate mapping applications and team chat threads just to figure out where they need to go. Copying and pasting coordinates, manually typing long addresses into third-party navigation tools, and losing track of shared client locations leads to wasted time, communication errors, and inefficient daily travel routes across the entire workforce.

Copying and pasting coordinates, manually typing long addresses into third-party navigation tools, and losing track of shared client locations leads to wasted time, communication errors, and inefficient daily travel routes across the entire workforce.

lines.say: To solve this problem, the new integration between Mappls and Zoho Arattai bridges the gap by bringing native location intelligence directly into your conversations. Instead of juggling multiple windows, your team can now interact with location data right inside the chat interface. This seamless combination streamlines your entire communication pipeline, ensuring that every field agent, dispatcher, and team manager stays perfectly synchronized with precise mapping data, live updates, and accurate route details all in one centralized workspace.

lines.say: To get started, simply open up Zoho Arattai on your mobile device or your desktop application. Navigate to your active team conversations or direct messages where your field operations take place. Once you are inside your preferred chat thread, you will immediately notice how smoothly location sharing and team updates are organized, preparing you to utilize the new Mappls mapping capabilities without needing any complicated third-party software installation or external configuration steps.

lines.say: Next, open your chat info or shared media details to confirm that your location services are properly linked. The Mappls integration works quietly in the background to ensure that any dropped pins, geographic coordinates, or client site addresses shared by your colleagues are automatically recognized and formatted for instant map viewing. Taking a quick second to verify this setup guarantees that your entire team can effortlessly access accurate location details the moment they are dropped into the conversation.

lines.say: Now comes the best part of the entire update. Whenever a teammate shares a location pin inside your Zoho Arattai chat, just tap directly on that shared pin. It will instantly launch turn by turn Mappls directions right on your screen, guiding you seamlessly to your destination without missing a beat. There is zero friction, zero manual address entry, and maximum efficiency for every single journey your field personnel take throughout the busy workday.
